Chiemi Ishimatsu (Japanese: 石松千恵美 Ishimatsu Chiemi) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Ishimatsu was born on May 5, 1976 in , , and became a voice actress as an adult. She started her work in the during the beginning of ' , voicing the Officer Jennys of Kalos. Ishimatsu is currently affiliated with the talent agency Ken Production.
